units.source_text: 终于叫了那个武士来，对他说：“这里出了怪事：妖魔把人迷住，痛苦得很。

en.t: At last he called that warrior over and said to him, "Something strange has happened here: an evil spirit has bewitched someone and caused terrible suffering.

units.source_text: 你赶快派个使者到惟光大夫住的地方去，叫他马上到这里来。

en.t: Quickly send a messenger to where the officer Koremitsu is staying, and tell him to come here at once.

units.source_text: 再秘密地告诉他：他的哥哥阿阇梨如果在他家，叫他带他同来。

en.t: Also tell him secretly that if his elder brother, the Ajari, is at his house, he should bring him along as well.

units.source_text: 他母亲知道了也许要责问，所以不可大声说话。

en.t: If his mother finds out, she may question him, so do not speak loudly.

units.source_text: 因为这尼姑是不赞许这种秘密行为的。”

en.t: For that nun does not approve of this kind of secret conduct."

units.source_text: 他嘴上侃侃而谈，其实胸中充塞了悲痛之情。

en.t: Though he spoke fluently and at length, his heart was in fact filled with grief.

units.source_text: 这个人的死去非常可哀，加之这环境的凄惨难于言喻。

en.t: This person's death was deeply pitiful, and the misery of the surroundings was beyond words.
